structured_output.failure_reason: Generation reached the 2200-token limit, entered repetitive output and terminated before producing valid JSON.

canonical_output.important_note: Exact evidence-span grounding is enforced deterministically and does not by itself guarantee correct semantic interpretation.

manual_clinical_evaluation.scope: Six representative held-out consultations covering the observed ASR WER range.
manual_clinical_evaluation.metric_interpretation: These are conservative clinician-note agreement metrics. PRI-MOCK57 clinician notes are not exhaustive transcripts; therefore some transcript-supported extra facts may count as false positives in the note-agreement calculation.

examples.description: Nausea was marked absent although the patient reported nausea; vomiting was the symptom that was denied.
The extraction combined blood in stool and urine as absent although only the stool negation was supported and urine colour was uncertain.

overall_interpretation: Qwen3-8B generally produced evidence-grounded structured clinical facts but showed incomplete clinical coverage, particularly for negations, fine-grained details and some management items. Human review remains necessary before approval.
